This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
after 4000 operating hours or when Δ P = 0.1 bar as indicated in the above 
titled block

The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 07 July 2003, accepted by by General Manager eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag, 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El-Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector.

Safety fence with caution marks

Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug

العمل المراد تنفيذه

Change 25% of the filters every 4000 
 operating hours

Inspect the air filters; replace the 
 damaged if it is required.

Check the system for leaks on a 
 regular base.

Treat any leaks that found with a 
 suitable sealing compound.

Clean the filters automatically by 
 self-cleaning system.
